internshipProgram.title: JBR Builders Civil Engineering & Architectural Internship Program
internshipProgram.tagline: Bridging Academic Theory with Real-World Ground Construction
internshipProgram.description: We actively nurture the next generation of civil engineers, architects, and structural designers from colleges across Tamil Nadu. Our internships provide genuine hard-hat site exposure, mentor-guided responsibility, and pathways to full-time engineering careers.
eligibility: Students pursuing Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech in Civil Engineering
Architecture students (B.Arch) seeking practical working drawing & 3D elevation exposure
Minimum 6.5 CGPA with a genuine passion for on-site structural works

modules.title: Site Execution & Surveying
modules.desc: Hands-on training with Total Station, optical levels, excavation alignment, and foundation marking.

modules.title: Concrete Technology & QA/QC
modules.desc: Live testing of concrete slump, cube compressive strength, aggregate testing, and curing verification.

modules.title: Bar Bending & Structural Detailing
modules.desc: Understanding structural blueprints, rebar ties, hook angles, lap lengths, and BBS calculation.

modules.title: Estimation & Quantity Surveying
modules.desc: Learning material takeoff, rate analysis, labor productivity tracking, and site cost management.

benefits: Official Internship Certificate & Performance Letter from JBR Builders
Direct mentorship from licensed engineers with 10+ years experience
Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) opportunities for outstanding performers
Safety gear (Hard-hat, high-vis jacket, tape measures) provided on site
